descriptionByLocale.en:
Would you like to gain more experience in the investment fund industry? Do you have an audit and risk mindset? We’re looking for a Fund Oversight Specialist in Poland to:

• Support the ManCo teams in fund tax oversight activities for various fund types.
• Conduct routine independent reviews of fund administration and tax provider processes.
• Assess and mitigate operational risks associated with tax activities.
• Provide administrative support for tax‑related processes.
• Maintain and continuously improve procedures.
• Support regulatory change management activities.
